source_row.extraction_instructions: LightMedia CMS, ASP.NET. The default /professionals/events/ is a month calendar; ?view=year returns the whole current year as a.date_row cards (span.event_date | h5 title | div.event_location). The next-year route /events/date/<YYYY>/?view=year answers Cloudflare 502 (origin error) for every /date/ URL on 2026-10-21, so the extractor tries it twice per year and otherwise falls back to sitemap.xml: event ids not in the year view and newer than (oldest listed id - 500) are fetched one by one (cap 60) and dated from the detail page's add-to-calendar-button JSON. Detail: h3.module_article_title, p.module_article_location, add-to-calendar-button dates='[{startDate,endDate,startTime}]' (reliable dates), tab-content with a [Ticket | Category | Price] table, 'free to attend' or deposit prose. Child items (dinners, accommodation, receptions) are skipped.

concerns: UNPROVEN / FRAGILE: every /professionals/events/date/... URL (year, month, week, day) returns a Cloudflare 502 for curl AND Playwright on 2026-10-21, so 2027 events are found through the sitemap fallback (25 upcoming shells: 17 from the 2026 year view, 8 from the sitemap). If the date routes recover the extractor uses them automatically; if sitemap.xml stops listing event URLs the extractor will see only the current year. The fallback costs up to ~45 detail fetches during the listing phase (cached, reused by extract_detail). Ask the Commander to check cloud access to sitemap.xml.

The forced-fallback run first lost the sitemap (Chromium's XML viewer failed the default 'page links to >1 place' check, fixed with expect_selector='loc') and the detail dates (Playwright serialises the add-to-calendar-button attribute with double quotes, fixed); shell counts now match (25 / 25).

Coverage checklist: #1 dates from add-to-calendar JSON; #2/#5 events whose fees are only on an organiser platform (ESSIC essicmeeting.eu Wix grid in EUR, Eventbrite, Arlo, FEDRA Congressi) are stored with pricing_tiers = [] after a one-hop attempt - JavaScript/Wix div grids are not parseable without a browser; #3 none seen; #4 BAUS pages have their ticket table in a 'Prices' tab on the same page (read); #6/#7 SUBMISSION_NO_DEADLINE warnings (PCUS, ESSIC) are left to the pipeline merge step.

BAUS Karl Storz Endoscopic Skills Course lists two rows both labelled 'Non-member' (£175 and £225) on the site itself (one is presumably the member rate); stored as printed. Refundable deposits (£49 registration deposit) are emitted as 'Refundable deposit' tiers when no fee table exists. 'Free to attend' pages get one £0 tier.

event_type uses title cues, then the first lines of the page (course / hands-on / FRCS -> course|workshop); webinars are 'workshop'. A few third-party events (LA Live Pre-AUA 2027 in Glendale CA, Techno-urology Turin, ESSIC London) are kept as BAUS lists them. Child events (dinners, accommodation) are skipped.

Text-LLM chain on 2026-10-21: nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b and meta/muse-glimmer-30b both answered 404 'gone', so the harness descriptions/specialties came from openai/gpt-oss-20b. Descriptions and specialty have deterministic backstops (first real paragraph; per-society default specialty), so extraction does not depend on the LLM. The probe_models job will go red until the chain is rotated.

specialty_classifier.classify_specialty is deliberately NOT used as the backstop: on single-specialty societies it returned wrong labels (Cardiology/Oncology/GP Training for hepatology webinars). The backstop is the society's own specialty constant when the LLM returns None.

Shared-helper wishes (not changed, per rules): pricing_tables.parse_pricing_tables keeps only the LAST price column when the header names are not timeframes (BSSH Scientific Meeting 'Full meeting | One day' lost the full-meeting rates), drops the category column of [Ticket | Category | Price] tables (BAUS), and can take a nearby sentence as the section name ('Registration fees do not include'). Each extractor carries a small local table helper instead (matrix_tiers / ticket_tiers / rowspan_tiers / external_fee_hop, duplicated inline per file).
coverage_checks SINGLE_DAY_SUSPECT / PRICE_TEXT_ON_PAGE warnings that remain in the harness are explained per source below; none is a missed fee or date on the event's own page.

2026-10-21 hardening: external hops (bookwhen/EventsAir/organiser sites) use safe_fetch.fetch_validated (30 s deadline, 2 MB cap), no browser fallback; host checks use urlparse().hostname. Society-own pages keep fetch_html.
